title: DiscoveryRunManifest
description: The audit anchor for a single Source Discovery Scout (R2) run. Every durable record the run produces (SourceCandidate, AccessReviewTask, NegativeFinding, CoverageGap) carries discovery_run_id equal to this manifest's discovery_run_id. The manifest records the run's scope, the local-language glossary/actor-map summary, the search summary, output counts, validation results, and references to the run-log artifacts (search_attempts / failed_searches / errors / raw_traces / glossary / discovered_source_categories / workstream_brief) which are kept as JSONL/markdown under data/run_logs and are NOT first-class schemas. It is sourcing-layer audit memory (architecture section 3/19), NOT Evidence/Claim/Signal/BankNeed/Opportunity. Counts are computed deterministically by the runner from the actual records, never asserted by an LLM. It hard-enforces the run-quality rules: a failed/aborted run must carry a reason; a completed run must have a completion time; and if any search failed, at least one NegativeFinding must exist (architecture section 21).

discovery_run_id.description: Unique run identifier. Every SourceCandidate/AccessReviewTask/NegativeFinding/CoverageGap produced by this run sets discovery_run_id to this value.

human_actor_id.description: Human who triggered the run, if any; else null.

created_at.description: When the manifest record was created (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

completed_at.description: When the run finished; null while running. Non-null required when run_status is completed/completed_with_errors (enforced below).

run_status.description: Run outcome. 'completed_with_errors' = finished but with recorded errors/validation issues; 'failed'/'aborted' require failure_reason (enforced below).

failure_reason.description: Why the run failed/aborted. MUST be a non-empty string when run_status is 'failed' or 'aborted' (enforced below); null otherwise.

scope.description: The country/workstream/topic/language scope of the run.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (or 'ZZ' for a global/multi-country run).

country_name.description: Display name, e.g. 'Greece'; null if not applicable.

workstreams.description: Workstream code(s) the run targeted (architecture section 16; A7 not defined).

languages.description: Search/coverage languages (BCP-47-like tags, e.g. 'en', 'el'). English-only is not sufficient (architecture section 18).

glossary_summary.description: Summary of the local-language glossary / actor map built for the run (architecture section 18). The full glossary is a run-log artifact; this carries the counts.

terms_validated.description: Terms validated against real results (not accepted merely because a model generated them).

noisy_risky.description: Terms usable only with disambiguators (e.g. the Greek 'προμήθεια' = procurement OR bank fee).

actors_identified.description: Distinct actors (banks, regulators, vendors, associations, etc.) mapped.

search_summary.description: Deterministic tallies of what the run searched and verified.

failed_searches.description: Searches that errored or returned nothing/only-noise. If > 0, at least one NegativeFinding is required (enforced below).

urls_verified.description: URLs deterministically verified by the runner (not asserted by an LLM).

outputs.description: Counts of durable records produced (computed by the runner from the actual records).

discovered_source_categories.description: Inferred source categories (a run-log artifact); an empty category should also surface as a CoverageGap.

run_log_refs.description: References (paths under data/run_logs or the run folder) to the run-log artifacts that are NOT first-class schemas. Null if not produced.

workstream_brief_ref.description: Path to the human-readable workstream_brief.md (compiled prose memory).

discovered_source_categories_ref.description: Path to the discovered_source_categories run-log artifact (the inferred source-category map).

all_outputs_schema_valid.description: Whether every emitted record validated against its schema.

dedup_by_normalized_url_applied.description: Whether deterministic dedup by normalized URL was applied (architecture section 19).

metadata.description: Optional free-form extension bag. The ONLY place additional properties are allowed.
